u0: Starting state: the agent does not carry the door-matching key. Objective: locate and pick up the key matching the locked door in the starting room; picking it up advances to u1.
u1: The agent holds the matching key and the door is still closed. Objective: carry the key to the locked door and toggle it open to advance to u2, while never dropping the key before the door is open (dropping it here fails into ufail).
u2: The matching key has been used and the door is open, granting access to the second room. Objective: drop the key if still held, then navigate to and pick up the mission-named box to finish in u3.
u3: Success terminal state: the mission's box has been picked up and the episode ends with full reward. No further objective; remain here.
ufail: Failure terminal state: the matching key was dropped while the door was still closed, so the door can no longer be opened. No recovery; the state persists to the end.
